_comment: Bones on the floor of the abyss -- vanilla's fossil, sited at the sea bed instead of buried in a desert.
**It works because of an accident worth writing down.** `FossilFeature` refuses to place where too many
corners of its bounding box are 'empty', and it counts air, lava and `minecraft:water` -- our deep water
is a different block and is therefore counted as solid ground. So a fossil laid in open abyss passes a
check that would have refused it in an ordinary ocean. If deep water ever becomes vanilla water, this
`fossil_coal` rather than the diamond variant: the coal reads as what is left of something that died and
was pressed, which is exactly what a whalefall is.
The `biome` filter at the end is what confines it -- it re-checks the biome at the chosen position, so
a sea bed that pokes above the abyss line gets nothing.
